scripts.docker:infra: docker-compose up -d postgres zookeeper kafka rabbitmq prometheus grafana redis mongodb
scripts.db:push: node -e "setTimeout(()=>{}, 3000)" && cd user-service && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && cd ../gamification-service && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n "GATEWAY,USER,GAMIF,COURSE,AI,OBS,QUERY,MFE,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,white,magenta,blue,red" "npm run dev:api-gateway" "npm run dev:user-service" "npm run dev:gamification-service" "npm run dev:course-service" "npm run dev:ai-service" "npm run dev:observability-service" "npm run dev:query-service" "npm run dev:mfe-terminal" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: npm run docker:infra && npm run db:push && npm run dev
